text:
jordan: Quick follow-up from today's 02:14 incident — want to align on owners & timelines for remediation. Error budget burned ~7% in ~3h on the inference API; p95 latency spikes and several retry storms. Need a concrete action sprint and dashboard alerts.

sam: agreed. i'll own the dashboard updates (grafana). i'll add per-route panels and a burn-rate alert. ETA: tomorrow morning. :white_check_mark:

mia: i'll take the routing/circuit-breaker changes and the canary policy. plan: add route-level throttles + a safe canary for traffic diversion. ETA: end of day Friday.

lee: i'll look at autoscaler thresholds and GPU pool headroom. suspect we need to tune scale-up cooldowns. need two days to validate in staging.

oliver: quick proposal — temporary SLO relaxation to avoid noise while we remediate: p95 latency 250ms -> 300ms for 7d. i know it's not ideal but could prevent churn while owners work. thoughts?

jordan: i'd prefer to avoid changing SLOs unless we have to. let's use canary + throttles first and only relax SLO as last resort. if error budget burn rate stays above 4%/day after mitigation, then we escalate to a temporary SLO window. agree to document decision path.

ada: i've opened a tracking board and an epic for the sprint: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INF-1234 — contains all sub-tasks and owners. dashboard link: https://grafana.redwood.ai/d/inf/latency-burn (i added shared panels).

jordan: Action items recap (owners & tentative ETA):
- dashboards: sam — update panels + add burn-rate alert — by 2025-07-18 09:00 PT
- route throttles & canary: mia — implement + run 50% canary for 6h — by 2025-07-18 EOD
- autoscale tuning: lee — change cooldowns & run soak tests — by 2025-07-20
- monitoring alerts & playbook notes: sam + mia — add runbook steps for oncall — by 2025-07-18
- temporary SLO decision: jordan/eng-sre lead — decision point if burn >4%/day after 48h of mitigation

oliver: i'll draft the SLO-relaxation RFC (if needed) and a rollback plan. putting a stub PR up now.

deploy-bot: PR #4281 merged into infra-playbooks (mia/dashboard-throttles) — deploy started. Logs: https://deploys.redwood.ai/4281

sam: small note — add a dashboard row that surfaces per-model p50/p95 and request rate to quickly spot model-level regressions.

mia: will do. also adding a synthetic test hitting the hot route every 5m.

lee: tagging @oncall rotation for visibility — please watch for any alert flapping. i'll post results of the scale tests in this thread.

jordan: thanks all. let's reconvene in 24h for a quick sync. if anyone hits blockers ping me directly. :eyes:
